references.text: Psalm 22:6-8 contains a prophecy describing mockery and scorn toward the Messiah, which mirrors the event in Matthew 27:37 where Jesus is mocked as 'King of the Jews'.
Mark 15:26 also describes the inscription placed above Jesus' head, providing a parallel to the event in Matthew 27:37.
Luke 23:38 also mentions the inscription about Jesus as 'King of the Jews', paralleling Matthew 27:37.
John 19:19 gives a detailed description of the inscription above Jesus' head, supporting the event described in Matthew 27:37.
